step 13: make /srv/data/paisans-f2a9 mode 700
  daemon: paisans-f2a9's Docker data is paisans-f2a9's alone; changed as paisans-f2a9
  run:
    $ runuser -u paisans-f2a9 -- env -i HOME='/home/paisans-f2a9' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1001 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1001/bus DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/1001/docker.sock sh -c 'chmod 700 '\''/srv/data/paisans-f2a9'\'''

step 14: write paisans-f2a9's daemon.json

  run:
    $ runuser -u paisans-f2a9 -- env -i HOME='/home/paisans-f2a9' PATH=/usr/bin:/bin:/usr/sbin:/sbin XDG_RUNTIME_DIR=/run/user/1001 DBUS_SESSION_BUS_ADDRESS=unix:path=/run/user/1001/bus DOCKER_HOST=unix:///run/user/1001/docker.sock sh -c 'umask 077 && mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/docker" && cat > "$HOME/.config/docker/.daemon.json.paisans-tmp" && mv -f "$HOME/.config/docker/.daemon.json.paisans-tmp" "$HOME/.config/docker/daemon.json"'

present: user: paisans-f2a9 exists, uid 1001, in no privileged group, and sudo grants it nothing beyond admit's helper
present: user: paisans-f2a9 holds 165536-231071 in /etc/subuid
present: user: paisans-f2a9 holds 165536-231071 in /etc/subgid
present: egress: the host's on-link IPv6 prefixes, dropped: 2001:db8:1::/64
present: linger: on for paisans-f2a9
present: linger: paisans-f2a9's manager is running
present: br_netfilter: nf_tables, which the host's iptables uses, is loaded
present: daemon: /srv/data (btrfs) has 42.9 GB free
present: mesh: nothing on this host overlaps 10.44.0.0/24
present: firewall: ufw active, its default policy left to the owner
warning: delegation reaches paisans-f2a9's manager at its next start
  Its manager is running, and restarting it would restart its Docker daemon and every container in it, so admit does not. cpuset and io limits apply after the host's next reboot.
warning: forwarding: this turns on routing between every interface on this host
  Other sites dial this one, so it relays mesh traffic between sites behind NAT, which cannot dial each other. The firewall's route rule relays the mesh, and its forward policy governs every other route.
